stem: Before publishing the report, journalists spent several weeks trying to ____ whether the leaked documents were genuine or had been fabricated.
explain_zh: ascertain 表示「查明、確定」（透過調查得知真相）；ignore（忽略）、publish（發表）、copy（複製）都無法表達「透過調查確認真偽」的意思。雅思閱讀學術文章常用 ascertain 描述研究者查證事實的過程。

stem: Investigators searched for additional witnesses whose testimony could ____ the account given by the driver involved in the collision.
explain_zh: corroborate 表示「（用證據）證實、支持既有說法」；contradict（反駁）語意相反，ignore（忽略）、replace（取代）都不符合「用新證據支持原本說法」。雅思閱讀學術文章常用 corroborate 描述證據互相印證。

stem: Based on data collected from just three cities, it would be risky to ____ conclusions about national trends without further research.
explain_zh: extrapolate 表示「（根據有限資料）推斷、外推」；summarise（總結）、ignore（忽略）、publish（發表）都無法表達「根據局部資料推論整體趨勢」，且句中 risky 暗示這種推論有風險。雅思閱讀統計類文章常用 extrapolate 描述以偏概全的推論風險。

stem: Traffic from three separate motorways ____ at this single junction, which explains why congestion here is so severe every morning.
explain_zh: converge 表示「匯聚、聚集於一點」；divide（分開）語意相反，avoid（避開）、bypass（繞道）都不符合「三條公路匯聚於同一路口」。雅思閱讀交通與都市規劃文章常用 converge 描述路線匯合。

stem: Pilots are trained never to ____ from the standard safety checklist, even when a flight is running behind schedule.
explain_zh: deviate from 表示「偏離（既定的規則或標準）」；benefit（受益）、differentiate（區分）、recover（恢復）語意都與「偏離安全檢查清單」不符。雅思閱讀常用 deviate from the norm/standard 描述違反常規的行為。

stem: The rapid rise of remote working during the pandemic perfectly ____ how quickly workplace habits can change under pressure.
explain_zh: exemplify 表示「（以實例）說明、體現」；prevent（阻止）、deny（否認）、avoid（避免）語意都與「作為具體例子來說明現象」不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 this exemplifies 引出具體例證支持論點。

stem: Although the contract never states it directly, there is an ____ agreement that both parties will renew the lease automatically each year.
explain_zh: implicit 表示「隱含的、未明說但理解一致的」；written（書面的）、formal（正式的）、official（官方的）都與「未直接寫明卻雙方心照不宣」矛盾。雅思閱讀常考 implicit 與 explicit（明確表達的）這組反義字。

stem: Years of chronic stress can eventually ____ as physical symptoms such as headaches, high blood pressure and insomnia.
explain_zh: manifest as 表示「顯現、表現出來」；disappear（消失）、weaken（削弱）、prevent（阻止）語意都與「壓力最終顯現為生理症狀」不符。雅思閱讀健康類文章常用 manifest as 描述某狀況最終以何種形式出現。

stem: The experiment produced only a small improvement in efficiency; the result was, ____ , considered a meaningful step forward by the research team.
explain_zh: nonetheless 表示「儘管如此」（表轉折，承認前面的限制但仍有正面結論）；therefore（因此，表因果）、likewise（同樣地）、meanwhile（同時）語意連接邏輯都不符合「雖然改善不大，但仍算有意義」的轉折關係。雅思寫作常用 nonetheless 連接讓步與結論。

stem: Consumers often ____ handmade products as being of higher quality than mass-produced items, even when the materials are identical.
explain_zh: perceive…as 表示「將…視為、認為」；ignore（忽略）、purchase（購買）、review（評論）都無法表達「消費者主觀認為某產品品質較高」。雅思閱讀行銷類文章常用 perceive…as 描述消費者的主觀認知。

stem: A brief safety briefing always ____ the start of the laboratory session, ensuring that every student understands the risks involved.
explain_zh: precede 表示「在…之前發生」；follow（在…之後，語意相反）、replace（取代）、cancel（取消）都不符合「安全講習在課程開始前進行」的先後順序。雅思閱讀常用 precede 描述事件發生的先後順序。

stem: Obesity-related illnesses have become far more ____ in urban areas, where fast food is cheap and physical activity is limited.
explain_zh: prevalent 表示「普遍存在的、盛行的」；rare（罕見的）語意相反，mild（輕微的）、isolated（孤立的）都不符合「在都市地區廣泛存在」。雅思閱讀健康類文章常用 prevalent 描述疾病或現象的普及程度。

stem: Before any new drug reaches the market, it must pass through a series of extremely ____ clinical trials to prove it is safe.
explain_zh: rigorous 表示「嚴謹、嚴格的」；casual（隨意的）、brief（簡短的）、optional（非必須的）都與「新藥上市前必須通過的嚴格試驗」矛盾。雅思閱讀學術方法論文章常用 rigorous testing/research 強調研究的嚴謹性。

stem: Unlike the rapidly growing tech sector, employment levels in this particular industry have remained largely ____ for the past fifteen years.
explain_zh: static 表示「靜止不變的」；flexible（有彈性的）、mobile（可移動的）、diverse（多樣的）都無法表達「長期維持不變」，且與句首 unlike the rapidly growing 形成對比。雅思寫作 Task 1 描述數據長期不變時可用 static 取代 stable。

stem: Examiners generally reward answers that are ____ and well-organised over those that repeat the same point in different words.
explain_zh: succinct 表示「簡潔扼要的」；repetitive（重複的）、vague（模糊的）、lengthy（冗長的）都與「簡潔有條理」的正面特質相反或不符。雅思口說與寫作評分都重視答案是否 succinct 而不拖泥帶水。

stem: A single one-hour visit to a country can only give a tourist a rather ____ understanding of its culture and history.
explain_zh: superficial 表示「表面的、膚淺的」；thorough（徹底的）、detailed（詳細的）、genuine（真正的）都與「短暫停留只能獲得表面認識」矛盾。雅思口說旅遊話題常用 superficial understanding 描述走馬看花式的認識。

stem: A shared belief in equal opportunity has long ____ the country's approach to designing its public education system.
explain_zh: underpin 表示「作為…的根基、支撐」（信念或制度背後的核心價值）；weaken（削弱）、replace（取代）、question（質疑）都無法表達「作為制度設計背後長期支撐的信念」。雅思閱讀政策類文章常用 underpin 描述某價值觀支撐整個制度。

stem: Share prices fell in an ____ manner after the company unexpectedly announced that its chief executive would be resigning immediately.
explain_zh: abrupt 表示「突然的、猝不及防的」；gradual（逐漸的）、steady（穩定的）、slow（緩慢的）都與「毫無預警地驟然下跌」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 描述數據毫無預警地急跌可用 abrupt。

stem: The company reported rising profits for five ____ quarters, a run that finally ended when raw material costs increased sharply.
explain_zh: consecutive 表示「連續不間斷的」；random（隨機的）、separate（分開的）、occasional（偶爾的）都無法表達「連續五季」的持續性。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 for five consecutive years/quarters 描述連續發生的期間。

stem: The retailer's latest figures show a ____ increase of eight percent, meaning sales this year were eight percent higher than the same period last year.
explain_zh: year-on-year 表示「年增率（與去年同期相比）」；monthly（每月的）、weekly（每週的）、hourly（每小時的）都與「和去年同期比較」的固定用法不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 a year-on-year increase/decrease 描述年度成長率。

vocab.zh: 年增的；與去年同期比較的

stem: City-centre rents continued to climb throughout the decade; ____ , rents in outlying suburbs fell slightly as residents moved further out.
explain_zh: conversely 表示「相反地」（用於對比兩個相反趨勢）；similarly（同樣地）、consequently（因此）、additionally（此外）語意連接邏輯都不符合「市中心租金上升，但郊區租金卻下跌」這種相反的對比關係。雅思寫作 Task 1 比較兩組相反趨勢時常用 conversely。

stem: As fuel prices rose sharply throughout the year, transport costs for local businesses increased ____ , squeezing their already thin profit margins.
explain_zh: correspondingly 表示「相應地」，指一項數據變動導致另一項也跟著變動；unexpectedly（出乎意料地）、occasionally（偶爾地）、rarely（很少地）都無法表達「燃料價格上升，運輸成本也跟著相應上升」的因果對應關係。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 correspondingly 連接兩組相關聯的數據變化。

stem: Investment in renewable energy has increased ____ since 2015, rising from around ten billion dollars to over thirty billion dollars annually.
explain_zh: threefold 表示「三倍地」，指數值成長為原本的三倍；slightly（些微地）、gradually（逐漸地）、marginally（些微地）都無法精確表達「成長為三倍」的具體倍數。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 increase threefold/twofold 描述數據成長的具體倍數。

stem: The number of applicants to the nursing programme has risen ____ over the past three years, reflecting growing interest in healthcare careers.
explain_zh: twofold 表示「兩倍地」，指成長為原本的兩倍；minimally（極少地）、negligibly（可忽略地）、slightly（些微地）都無法表達「成長為兩倍」的具體幅度。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 twofold 描述數據翻倍成長。

stem: If the current growth rate continues, experts predict that the city's population could ____ within the next fifty years.
explain_zh: quadruple 表示「變成四倍」；stabilise（穩定下來）、decline（下降）、plateau（持平）都與「成長為四倍」的預測不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 描述長期急遽成長的預測時可用 quadruple 表達四倍成長。

stem: Online grocery orders ____ during the first year of the pandemic as more households avoided visiting physical supermarkets.
explain_zh: triple 表示「變成三倍」；halved（減半）語意相反，stabilised（穩定下來）、paused（暫停）都不符合「訂單量大幅增加為三倍」。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 triple 描述數據成長為三倍。

stem: Housing supply in the city has failed to ____ demand for over a decade, which explains why property prices keep rising.
explain_zh: outstrip 表示「超越、超過」，指成長速度快過另一項；measure（測量）、satisfy（滿足，語氣較弱）、replace（取代）都無法精準表達「供給成長速度未能超過需求」。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 demand outstrips supply 描述供不應求的現象。

stem: In this particular university department, female students now ____ male students by almost two to one, a striking reversal of the pattern seen a generation ago.
explain_zh: outnumber 表示「數量超過」；resemble（相似）、equal（等於）、join（加入）都無法表達「女學生人數超過男學生」的比較關係。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 outnumber 描述兩個群體數量上的差距。

stem: Rural broadband speeds continue to ____ those in major cities, despite government promises to close the digital divide by next year.
explain_zh: lag behind 表示「落後於」；keep up with（跟上）、surpass（超越）、mirror（反映；相似）語意都與「鄉村網路速度落後於城市」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 lag behind 描述某項數據落後於另一項。

stem: The two countries' economic growth rates began to ____ sharply after one adopted strict austerity measures while the other continued heavy public spending.
explain_zh: diverge 表示（趨勢）「分歧、朝不同方向發展」；align（一致）、merge（合併）、match（相符）都與「兩國經濟成長走向截然不同」相反。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 diverge 描述兩條原本相近的趨勢線分開。

stem: House prices finally appeared to ____ in the third quarter, giving cautious buyers their first sign of stability in over a year.
explain_zh: bottom out 表示（下跌後）「觸底」；accelerate（加速）、climb（攀升）、surge（激增）都與「下跌後終於觸底」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 bottom out 描述數據跌到最低點後止跌。

stem: Unemployment among recent graduates reached an ____ last year, prompting the government to introduce several new job-training schemes.
explain_zh: all-time high 表示「史上最高點」；average level（平均水準）、minor drop（小幅下跌）、temporary dip（暫時下滑）都與「達到史上最高」的語意矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 reach an all-time high/low 描述數據創下歷史新高或新低。

stem: The factory produced a ____ number of vehicles last quarter, surpassing every previous output figure in the company's forty-year history.
explain_zh: record-breaking 表示「破紀錄的」；disappointing（令人失望的）、average（平均的）、modest（適度的）都與「超越歷來所有紀錄」矛盾。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 a record-breaking figure 描述創新高的數據。

stem: Trends in this smaller regional market closely ____ those seen nationally, making it a useful indicator for predicting countrywide sales.
explain_zh: mirror 表示「反映、與…相似」（如鏡子般映照出相同的模式）；oppose（反對）、ignore（忽略）、distort（扭曲）都與「地區市場趨勢與全國趨勢高度相似」不符。雅思寫作 Task 1 常用 mirror 描述兩組數據走勢高度相似。

stem: The lawyer's closing statement was widely regarded as the most ____ part of the entire trial, swaying several jurors who had earlier seemed undecided.
explain_zh: persuasive 表示「有說服力的」；technical（技術性的）、lengthy（冗長的）、formal（正式的）都無法表達「成功說服陪審團」的效果。雅思寫作 Task 2 高分文章需要提出 persuasive arguments 說服讀者。

stem: Although the salesman spoke confidently, his explanation for the sudden price increase was far from ____ and left several customers suspicious.
explain_zh: convincing 表示「令人信服的」；formal（正式的）、brief（簡短的）、technical（技術性的）都與「令人信服」不符，且句中「left customers suspicious」暗示解釋並不具說服力。雅思閱讀常考作者對某論點是否 convincing 的評價。

stem: Reviewers found the company's explanation for the data breach ____ , noting that it failed to address why the security update had been delayed for months.
explain_zh: unconvincing 表示「不具說服力的」；thorough（徹底的）、detailed（詳細的）、transparent（透明的）都與「未能說明延遲原因，缺乏說服力」的批評矛盾。雅思閱讀常考評論者是否認為某解釋 unconvincing。

stem: Despite its obvious flaws, the proposal does have some ____ , particularly in how it addresses the shortage of affordable housing.
explain_zh: merit 表示「優點、可取之處」；risk（風險）、cost（成本）、delay（延誤）都無法表達「儘管有缺點，仍有值得肯定的優點」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 have merit 承認對立觀點仍有部分道理。

stem: One major ____ of working from home is that many employees find it harder to separate their professional and personal lives.
explain_zh: drawback 表示「缺點、不利之處」；advantage（優點）、benefit（益處）語意相反，incentive（誘因）也不符合「難以區分工作與生活」這個負面影響。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 one drawback of 引出某項政策或做法的缺點。

stem: The main ____ to living in the city centre is the noise, which many residents say disturbs their sleep almost every night.
explain_zh: downside 表示「缺點、不利的一面」；appeal（吸引力）、attraction（吸引人之處）、benefit（好處）語意都相反或不符。雅思口說與寫作常用 the downside of 引出某件事的缺點。

stem: A strong Task 2 essay should acknowledge at least one ____ before explaining why the writer's own position is still more convincing.
explain_zh: counterargument 表示「反方論點」；summary（摘要）、introduction（引言）、conclusion（結論）都與「承認並回應對立觀點」的寫作技巧不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 高分文章常會先承認 counterargument 再加以反駁。

stem: After the opposing team presented their evidence, the debate captain offered a sharp ____ that undermined almost every point they had made.
explain_zh: rebuttal 表示「反駁（的言論）」；summary（摘要）、apology（道歉）、introduction（引言）都與「提出有力反駁削弱對方論點」不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 中提出 rebuttal 是反駁對立觀點的重要技巧。

stem: To the argument that remote work reduces productivity, researchers offer a useful ____ : several studies show output actually rising when staff work from home.
explain_zh: counterpoint 表示「反駁的論點、對立觀點」；repetition（重複）、summary（摘要）、warning（警告）都無法表達「提出相反證據來反駁某個論點」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 offer a counterpoint 引出對立的證據或看法。

stem: Blaming rising crime rates solely on poverty may ____ a problem that is actually shaped by many interconnected social factors.
explain_zh: oversimplify 表示「過度簡化」（忽略複雜的成因）；clarify（釐清）、resolve（解決）、examine（檢視）都無法表達「將複雜問題簡化成單一原因」的批評語意。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 oversimplify 批評把複雜議題歸咎單一原因的論述。

stem: Some newspaper headlines ____ the risks of the new technology in order to attract more readers and generate stronger reactions online.
explain_zh: exaggerate 表示「誇大」；minimise（降到最低）語意相反，measure（測量）、calculate（計算）都不符合「誇大風險以吸引讀者」。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 exaggerate 批評媒體誇大其詞的報導方式。

stem: It would be easy to ____ how much daily commuting affects a worker's overall stress levels and long-term physical health.
explain_zh: understate 表示「輕描淡寫、低估」；exaggerate（誇大）語意相反，calculate（計算）、publicise（公開宣傳）都與「容易忽略通勤對健康的實際影響程度」不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 understate 描述某項影響被低估的情況。

stem: Consumer groups warned that the advertisement's claim of being ninety percent natural was ____ , since most of that percentage came from added water.
explain_zh: misleading 表示「誤導人的」；accurate（準確的）、standard（標準的）、typical（典型的）都與「廣告聲稱誤導消費者」的批評矛盾。雅思閱讀廣告與消費者權益文章常用 misleading claims 描述不實廣告。

stem: The packaging made the snack appear far healthier than it actually was, a ____ design choice that regulators have since asked the company to change.
explain_zh: deceptive 表示「有欺騙性的」；transparent（透明的）、honest（誠實的）語意相反，standard（標準的）也不符合「刻意讓商品看起來比實際更健康」的批評。雅思閱讀消費者議題文章常用 deceptive packaging/advertising 描述誤導性的行銷手法。

stem: Without any solid data to support it, the analyst's prediction that the market would crash within a month remained purely ____ .
explain_zh: speculative 表示「推測性的、缺乏根據的臆測」；proven（已證明的）、verified（已驗證的）、confirmed（已確認的）都與「沒有可靠資料支持，純屬臆測」矛盾。雅思閱讀財經類文章常用 speculative 描述缺乏根據的市場預測。

stem: The tabloid's report about the celebrity's secret illness was entirely ____ , as no hospital or representative ever confirmed the story.
explain_zh: unsubstantiated 表示「未經證實的」；factual（基於事實的）、official（官方的）、verified（已驗證的）都與「沒有任何醫院或代表證實此消息」矛盾。雅思閱讀媒體議題文章常用 unsubstantiated claims/reports 描述未經查證的報導。

stem: At first the idea of delivering parcels by drone seemed ____ , yet within a decade several major retailers had adopted the technology.
explain_zh: far-fetched 表示「不切實際的、難以置信的」；practical（實際的）、common（常見的）、standard（標準的）都與「起初聽起來難以置信」矛盾，且後半句「十年內卻被廣泛採用」形成轉折對比。雅思口說與寫作常用 far-fetched 描述一開始聽起來不可能的想法。

vocab.zh: 不切實際的；難以置信的

stem: Local ____ have spent years campaigning to protect the wetland from being drained for a new housing development.
explain_zh: conservationist 表示「自然保育人士」；investors（投資者）、developers（開發商）、contractors（承包商）都與「保護濕地不被開發」的立場相反。雅思閱讀環境類文章常用 conservationists 指稱推動保育行動的人。

stem: Scientists discovered a growing hole in the ____ above Antarctica in the 1980s, which led to an international agreement banning certain harmful chemicals.
explain_zh: ozone layer 表示「臭氧層」；water table（地下水位）、food chain（食物鏈）、coral reef（珊瑚礁）都與「南極上空出現破洞」的地點不符。雅思閱讀環境史文章常提到 the hole in the ozone layer 這個經典議題。

stem: Emissions from coal-fired power stations were once a major cause of ____ , which damaged forests and lakes across large parts of Europe.
explain_zh: acid rain 表示「酸雨」；soil erosion（土壤侵蝕）、drought（乾旱）、desertification（沙漠化）都與「燃煤發電廠排放物損害森林與湖泊」的具體現象不符。雅思閱讀環境史文章常提到 acid rain 這個曾經嚴重的污染問題。

stem: Despite strict international bans, ____ remains one of the greatest threats to endangered species such as rhinos and elephants.
explain_zh: poaching 表示「盜獵」，即非法獵捕保育類動物；farming（農耕）、fishing（捕魚）、hunting（狩獵，未必違法）都不如 poaching 精準對應「違反國際禁令、獵捕瀕危動物」的行為。雅思閱讀野生動物保育文章常用 poaching 描述非法獵捕。

stem: As more companies move their operations online, investment in ____ has become essential to protect sensitive customer information from hackers.
explain_zh: cybersecurity 表示「網路資安」；advertising（廣告）、logistics（物流）、accounting（會計）都與「保護客戶資料免受駭客攻擊」無關。雅思口說 Part 3 科技話題常討論 cybersecurity 的重要性。

stem: The streaming service uses a complex ____ to recommend films based on what similar viewers have previously enjoyed watching.
explain_zh: algorithm 表示「演算法」（一套用來處理資料、做出決策的規則）；database（資料庫）、browser（瀏覽器）、network（網路）語意都與「用來推薦內容的運算規則」不完全相符。雅思口說與閱讀科技話題常用 algorithm 描述推薦系統背後的運算邏輯。

stem: Everything a person posts, likes or searches for online contributes to a permanent ____ that can be traced by future employers.
explain_zh: digital footprint 表示「數位足跡」，指個人在網路上留下的所有活動紀錄；credit rating（信用評等）、medical record（病歷）、criminal record（犯罪紀錄）都與「網路上留下的個人活動痕跡」不符。雅思口說科技話題常討論 digital footprint 對隱私的影響。

stem: The company faced significant financial losses after a ____ exposed the personal details of millions of its customers to hackers.
explain_zh: data breach 表示「資料外洩事件」；merger（合併）、shortage（短缺）、blackout（停電）都與「駭客取得數百萬客戶個資」的情境不符。雅思閱讀科技與隱私文章常用 data breach 描述資安漏洞事件。

stem: Online banking apps rely on strong ____ to prevent hackers from reading sensitive information as it travels across the internet.
explain_zh: encryption 表示「加密技術」；storage（儲存）、bandwidth（頻寬）、connectivity（連結性）都與「防止駭客讀取敏感資訊」的具體防護手段不符。雅思口說與閱讀科技話題常用 encryption 描述保護資料安全的技術。

stem: Manufacturers have been criticised for designing products with built-in ____ , meaning devices are made to stop working after just a few years.
explain_zh: obsolescence 表示「淘汰、過時」（built-in obsolescence 指刻意設計成短時間內就會過時故障）；durability（耐用性）、warranty（保固）、efficiency（效率）語意都與「刻意讓產品提早故障」的批評相反或不符。雅思閱讀消費議題文章常用 built-in obsolescence 批評廠商的行銷策略。

stem: Ride-sharing apps are often described as ____ because they completely transformed the traditional taxi industry within just a few years.
explain_zh: disruptive technology 表示「顛覆性科技」（徹底改變既有產業運作方式的創新）；routine software（例行軟體）、standard equipment（標準設備）、basic infrastructure（基礎建設）都無法表達「徹底顛覆傳統產業」。雅思口說與閱讀科技話題常用 disruptive technology 描述改變市場規則的創新。

stem: Rather than buying physical DVDs, most households now watch films and television programmes through ____ services accessed directly over the internet.
explain_zh: streaming 表示「串流」（透過網路即時播放內容，不需下載完整檔案）；broadcasting（廣播）、cable（有線電視）、satellite（衛星）都是不同的傳輸方式，與「直接透過網路收看」的 streaming 不同。雅思口說娛樂話題常討論 streaming services 取代傳統電視的趨勢。

stem: Some universities now use ____ headsets to let medical students practise surgical procedures safely before working on real patients.
explain_zh: virtual reality 表示「虛擬實境」；audio recording（錄音）、printed material（印刷教材）、video conferencing（視訊會議）都與「配戴頭戴式裝置模擬手術情境」的技術不符。雅思閱讀教育科技文章常用 virtual reality 描述沉浸式學習工具。

stem: Retail companies now analyse ____ generated by millions of customer transactions to predict which products will sell well next season.
explain_zh: big data 表示「巨量資料」（規模龐大、須用特殊技術分析的資料集）；paperwork（文書工作）、artwork（藝術品）、folklore（民俗傳說）都與「分析數百萬筆交易紀錄」無關。雅思口說與閱讀科技話題常用 big data 描述企業用來預測趨勢的龐大資料。

stem: Doctors warn that an increasingly ____ lifestyle, spent mostly sitting at desks or in front of screens, is contributing to rising rates of heart disease.
explain_zh: sedentary 表示「久坐少動的」；active（活躍的）語意相反，balanced（均衡的）、varied（多樣的）都與「大部分時間坐著，缺乏活動」的生活型態不符。雅思口說健康話題常用 sedentary lifestyle 討論久坐對健康的影響。

stem: In some low-income regions, childhood ____ remains widespread despite international aid programmes designed to improve access to nutritious food.
explain_zh: malnutrition 表示「營養不良」；obesity（肥胖，通常指營養過剩而非不足）、allergy（過敏）、insomnia（失眠）都與「缺乏足夠營養食物」的語境不符。雅思閱讀開發中國家健康議題文章常用 malnutrition 描述營養攝取不足的問題。

stem: New cars typically ____ rapidly in value during their first year, which is why many buyers prefer slightly older second-hand models.
explain_zh: depreciate 表示（資產）「貶值」；appreciate（升值）語意相反，accumulate（累積）、expand（擴張）都不符合「新車第一年價值迅速下降」。雅思閱讀財經類文章常考 depreciate 與 appreciate 這組意義相反的字。

stem: The training programme is divided into five ____ modules, each of which can be completed independently in any order the learner prefers.
explain_zh: discrete 指「個別分開的、獨立的」，用來形容可各自獨立完成的單元最恰當；discreet 指「謹慎、不張揚的」，拼字相近但意義完全不同；continuous（連續的）、combined（合併的）則與「獨立分開的單元」相反。雅思閱讀常考 discrete 與 discreet 這組同音異義字。

stem: Customs officers at the border seized a large shipment of ____ goods that had been smuggled in without the required import documents.
explain_zh: illicit 表示「非法的、違禁的」；surplus（過剩的）、imported（進口的，語意中性）、damaged（受損的）都無法表達「走私、違反法律」。雅思閱讀常考 illicit 與 elicit（引出、誘出）這組發音相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Before sealing the ____ , she checked twice to make sure she had included every document the university had requested.
explain_zh: envelope 表示「信封」，符合「密封信封前檢查文件」的語境；envoy 指「使節、特使」，envision 指「想像、預想」，environment 指「環境」，語意或詞性都不符合這個情境。雅思閱讀常考 envelope 與 envelop（動詞「包住」）這組拼字相近的字。

stem: The building now used as a public library was ____ a textile factory, employing hundreds of local workers throughout the twentieth century.
explain_zh: formerly 表示「從前、以前」，用來說明建築物過去的用途；formally 指「正式地」，拼字相近但意義完全不同；briefly（短暫地）、rarely（很少地）語意也不符合「過去曾經是紡織工廠」。雅思閱讀常考 formerly 與 formally 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Many long-term employees were ____ to accept the relocation package, fearing it would disrupt their families and children's schooling.
explain_zh: loath to 表示「不情願的、勉強的」；eager（渴望的）、willing（願意的）、quick（迅速的）都與「不願意接受搬遷方案」相反。雅思閱讀常考 loath 與 loathe（動詞「厭惡」）這組拼字相近但詞性不同的字。

stem: Before recommending the treatment, the specialist carried out an ____ review of the patient's entire medical history going back over twenty years.
explain_zh: exhaustive 表示「詳盡無遺的、徹底的」，用來形容仔細審查病歷二十年紀錄最恰當；casual（隨意的）、brief（簡短的）、partial（部分的）都與「徹底審查」矛盾。雅思閱讀常考 exhaustive 與 exhausting（令人筋疲力竭的）這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Rising life expectancy brings not only medical benefits but also significant ____ challenges, such as how to fund pensions for a much older population.
explain_zh: societal 表示「社會層面的」，用來形容整體社會面臨的挑戰最恰當；personal（個人的）、physical（身體的）、seasonal（季節性的）都與「如何為高齡人口提供年金」這個社會層面問題不符。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 societal challenges/issues 討論社會整體面臨的問題。

stem: Even as an adult, the artist retained a ____ sense of wonder that clearly influenced the playful, colourful style of her paintings.
explain_zh: childlike 表示（正面意義）「孩子般天真的」，用來形容藝術家保有純真的驚奇感最恰當；childish 通常帶「幼稚、不成熟」的負面意涵，immature（不成熟的）、foolish（愚蠢的）語氣也偏負面，與句中讚賞藝術家風格的語境不符。雅思閱讀常考 childlike 與 childish 這組意義褒貶不同的近義字。

stem: The museum's new exhibit was designed to be a rich ____ experience, combining sound, light and touch to engage visitors of all ages.
explain_zh: sensory 表示「感官的」，用來形容結合聲音、光線與觸覺的體驗最恰當；sensitive（敏感的）、sensible（明智的）、sentimental（多愁善感的）語意都不符合「感官體驗」。雅思閱讀常考 sensory 與 sensitive 這組字形相近但意義不同的詞。

stem: The critic's ____ review dismissed the entire exhibition as a shallow attempt to attract publicity rather than genuine art.
explain_zh: contemptuous 表示「輕蔑的、鄙視的」，符合「評論家全盤否定展覽」的語氣；respectful（尊敬的）、balanced（平衡的）、cautious（謹慎的）語意都與「輕蔑地全盤否定」不符。雅思閱讀常考 contemptuous 與 contemptible（可鄙的，形容被輕視的對象）這組易混淆字。

stem: Signing the peace treaty was a ____ moment in the country's history, ending nearly two decades of conflict between the two regions.
explain_zh: momentous 表示「重大的、具有深遠意義的」，用來形容結束長年衝突的歷史時刻最恰當；momentary 指「短暫的」，拼字相近但意義完全不同，trivial（瑣碎的）、minor（次要的）也與「具有重大歷史意義」矛盾。雅思閱讀常考 momentous 與 momentary 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: The abandoned garden had become almost unrecognisable, overtaken by ____ vegetation that had not been trimmed in over a decade.
explain_zh: luxuriant 表示（植物）「茂盛繁密的」，用來形容十年未修剪、長得極為茂密的植被最恰當；sparse（稀疏的）、withered（枯萎的）語意相反，artificial（人造的）也不符合。雅思閱讀常考 luxuriant 與 luxurious（奢華的，通常形容物質享受而非植物）這組易混淆字。

stem: Once the safety inspection had been completed, engineers were finally given permission to ____ with the final stage of construction.
explain_zh: proceed with 表示「繼續進行」；precede 指「在…之前發生」，拼字相近但意義相反；succeed 指「成功；繼承」，recede 指「後退、減弱」，語意都不符合「獲准繼續進行工程」。雅思閱讀常考 proceed 與 precede 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: The professor's lecture on supply and demand is considered a ____ example of how to explain a complex economic idea in simple terms.
explain_zh: classic 表示「經典的、典型的」，用來形容一個廣為公認的最佳範例最恰當；classified 指「機密的；分類的」，classical 通常指「古典（時期）的」，classy 指「時髦優雅的」，語意都不符合「教科書式的經典範例」。雅思閱讀常考 classic 與 classical 這組拼字相近但意義不同的字。

stem: Despite years of disagreement over finances, the two business partners eventually reached an ____ settlement that allowed both to move on without further conflict.
explain_zh: amicable 表示「友好的、和睦的」，用來形容雙方在沒有進一步衝突下達成的和解最恰當；hostile（敵對的）語意相反，forced（被迫的）、delayed（延遲的）也不符合「友好和解」的語境。雅思閱讀常考 amicable 與 amiable（形容人「親切隨和的」，而非形容協議或關係）這組易混淆字。

stem: Traffic on the motorway remained almost completely ____ for over an hour after the accident blocked all three lanes.
explain_zh: stationary 表示「靜止不動的」，用來形容車輛因事故完全動彈不得最恰當；flexible（有彈性的）、portable（可攜帶的）、mobile（可移動的）都與「完全靜止不動」相反。雅思閱讀常考 stationary 與 stationery（文具，拼字非常相近但意義完全不同）這組易混淆字。

stem: Elderly residents who live alone are often eligible for government ____ with everyday tasks such as shopping, cleaning and cooking.
explain_zh: 空格前有 government，且介系詞 with 前需要名詞，故選 assistance（協助）；assistant 指「助理（人）」，assisted 是形容詞或過去分詞，assist 是動詞，詞性或語意都不符合句子結構。雅思閱讀社福議題文章常考同字根的詞性變化。

stem: Researchers found little measurable ____ between the two groups' exam results, suggesting that the new teaching method had limited impact.
explain_zh: 空格前有形容詞 measurable 修飾，需要名詞，故選 difference（差異）；differ 是動詞，different 是形容詞，differently 是副詞，詞性都不符合句子結構。雅思聽力填空題常考此類名詞化的詞性變化。

stem: Many retired people describe gardening as an extremely ____ way to spend their free time while also staying physically active.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 way，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 pleasurable（令人愉悅的）；pleasure 是名詞，pleasing 通常指「令人滿意的（較正式）」用法略有不同，please 是動詞，都不如 pleasurable 精確符合句子結構。雅思口說興趣話題常用 pleasurable 形容令人愉快的活動。

stem: Volunteers with medical training proved absolutely ____ during the disaster relief effort, saving many lives in the first critical hours.
explain_zh: invaluable 表示「極為寶貴、無價的」，語氣比 valuable 更強烈，符合「拯救許多生命」的重要貢獻；valued（受重視的）、valuable（有價值的）語氣較弱，worthless（毫無價值的）語意相反。雅思閱讀常考 invaluable 這個看似否定但實為「非常有價值」的正面詞。

stem: The government's recycling campaign was promoted ____ , reaching small rural towns as well as the country's largest cities.
explain_zh: 空格在 was promoted 之後，需要副詞修飾動詞（表示「在全國範圍內宣傳」），故選 nationally（全國性地）；national 是形容詞，nation 是名詞，nationalise 是動詞「使國有化」，詞性或語意都不符合這個句子結構。雅思閱讀政策類文章常考同字根的詞性變化。

stem: Although the two neighbouring countries share a border, they are ____ quite distinct, with different languages, cuisines and traditions.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 distinct，需要副詞，故選 culturally（在文化上）；culture 是名詞，cultural 是形容詞，cultured 指「有教養的」，詞性或語意都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思口說文化話題常用 culturally distinct/diverse 這類詞組。

stem: The company's claim that its skincare product reverses ageing has never been ____ tested by any independent laboratory.
explain_zh: 空格修飾動詞 tested（被動語態），需要副詞，故選 scientifically（以科學方式）；science 是名詞，scientist 是名詞（科學家），scientific 是形容詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾動詞」的結構。雅思閱讀廣告不實議題文章常用 scientifically tested/proven 這類詞組。

stem: Long-term unemployment can cause serious ____ effects, including anxiety, low self-esteem and a loss of daily structure and purpose.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 effects，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 psychological（心理上的）；psychology 是名詞，psychologist 是名詞（心理學家），psychologically 是副詞，詞性都不符合「形容詞加名詞」的結構。雅思閱讀健康與工作議題文章常用 psychological effects/impact 這類詞組。

stem: Some remote island communities around the world remain heavily ____ dependent on a single industry such as fishing or tourism.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 dependent，需要副詞，故選 economically（經濟上）；economic 是形容詞，economy 是名詞，economise 是動詞「節省開支」，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思寫作 Task 2 常用 economically dependent on 討論產業結構單一的風險。

stem: People who work from home full time sometimes feel increasingly ____ isolated, since they miss the casual daily interaction of an office.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 isolated，需要副詞，故選 socially（在社交上）；social 是形容詞，society 是名詞，socialise 是動詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思口說遠距工作話題常用 socially isolated 描述缺乏人際互動的狀態。

stem: ____ , the region relied almost entirely on agriculture, but today most of its income comes from tourism and light manufacturing.
explain_zh: 句首需要副詞來修飾整個句子（表示「在過去」），故選 Historically；History 是名詞，Historic 是形容詞，Historian 是名詞（歷史學家），詞性都不符合句首副詞的位置。雅思閱讀常用 Historically 開頭，對比過去與現在的情況。

stem: Twins raised in completely different households still share many ____ similarities, which researchers use to study the influence of genetics.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 similarities，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 biological（生物學上的）；biology 是名詞，biologist 是名詞（生物學家），biologically 是副詞，詞性都不符合「形容詞加名詞」的結構。雅思閱讀科學類文章常用 biological similarities/differences 這類詞組。

stem: The invention was scientifically impressive, but it took another decade before the technology became ____ viable enough to sell to the public.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 viable，需要副詞，故選 commercially（商業上）；commercial 是形容詞，commerce 是名詞，commercialise 是動詞，詞性都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思閱讀科技創新文章常用 commercially viable 這類詞組。

stem: Many students find that living away from home for the first time is ____ challenging, especially before they learn to budget properly.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 challenging，需要副詞，故選 financially（財務上）；finance 是名詞或動詞，financial 是形容詞，financier 是名詞（金融家），詞性都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思口說留學話題常用 financially challenging/independent 這類詞組。

stem: The proposed reform was widely seen as ____ risky, since it threatened to alienate voters in several traditionally loyal regions.
explain_zh: 空格修飾形容詞 risky，需要副詞，故選 politically（政治上）；politics 是名詞，political 是形容詞，politician 是名詞（政治人物），詞性都不符合「副詞修飾形容詞」的結構。雅思閱讀政治議題文章常用 politically risky/sensitive 這類詞組。

stem: Even within a single country, there can be significant ____ variation in dialect, cuisine and local customs from one region to another.
explain_zh: 空格後接名詞 variation，前面需要形容詞修飾，故選 geographical（地理上的）；geography 是名詞，geographer 是名詞（地理學家），geographically 是副詞，詞性都不符合「形容詞加名詞」的結構。雅思閱讀地理與文化議題文章常用 geographical variation/diversity 這類詞組。
